column3: Starlet Motel then Moses garage, Port Gellhorn
column4: Chapter 2+; inspect reception missing-person poster (L2/LT), then enter overgrown warehouse across from Moses via right-wall crawl gap. Photograph 3 locker-room clues. If the motel is inaccessible, inspect the poster outside the 247 south of Delights. The curved-roof warehouse is north/northeast of Moses; use the crawl opening on its northeast wall if the shutter is locked. Look for the red-lit room leading to the lockers.

column3: Port Gellhorn junkyard east of Pay n Spray
column4: Open trunk of pink PRTYGRL car (another wreck stacked above). Inspect victim; report to Kelly County Tip Line. Susanne Keeble: look for the No Parking sign at the junkyard fence; the pink car is beyond it. The linked map image shows all three victim sites.

column3: Northern Port Gellhorn abandoned trailer park
column4: Under rusted water tower find pale blue-green trailer. Lift loose floorboard on right and report second victim. Patrick Murray: west of Hank's Waffles, enter the trailer nearest the water tower fence; a barking dog is reported by the doorway. The linked map image shows all three victim sites.

column3: Marsh west of Port Gellhorn near Wild Hog Point
column4: At broken leaning tree beside small marsh lake, inspect half-sunken rusty station wagon; report third victim. Beware alligators. Donald Miller: locate the C-shaped pond between the town and airstrip, just before the Wild Hog Point bridge. The linked map image shows all three victim sites.

column3: Moses garage warehouse; abandoned mine near Mount Kalaga
column4: Return after 3 tip calls. Spoilers: go in ALONE to trigger partner kidnapping and mine rescue; follow phone message, get crowbar, free partner and confront Alvan West. Glasses are route-dependent. The follow-up starts after returning to the trophy room; the mine is in the Kalaga Reservoir area of Lummox County. Completing the mission reportedly increases the protagonists' relationship.
